title: Samsung S10+/Android 10 BG reading every 15-25 minutes
symptom: On a Samsung S10+ running Android 10, the app only gets readings every 15-25 minutes or only when manually restarting the collector.
fix: Downloaded the 1-24-2020 Nightly build and for Bluetooth settings only check 'Turn Bluetooth on' and 'Use Background Scans', leaving everything else unchecked.
settings_changed: Bluetooth settings → only check Turn Bluetooth on and Use Background Scans
evidence_quote: I think I have found a resolution: Downloaded 1-24-2020 Nightly build. For Bluetooth settings only check: Turn Bluetooth on, and Use Background Scans. Everything else should be unchecked.
